inputs.name: collectAuditedFiles.root
inputs.description: The filesystem path passed to collectAuditedFiles determines where recursive collection begins. The function passes it to readdir without validation, so the path must be readable by the process.

outputs.name: collectAuditedFiles
outputs.description: The resolved CollectedFiles object contains files with a joined path and lower-case extension for each non-directory, non-symlink entry, dirs with visited paths relative to the root ending in /, and ignoredPaths for symbolic links and skipped directories. Skipped directory names come from a fixed ignore set, and their paths end in /. Godot editor caches named .godot are skipped.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A filesystem error from readdir or lstat rejects the promise and propagates to the caller because the implementation does not catch or translate it.
